title: Classic French-style Omelet
description: Classic French-style Omelet is an elegant breakfast dish known for its delicate, silky texture and smooth pale-yellow exterior. Gently cooked over low heat and folded into a tender oval, this timeless French classic showcases the richness of eggs with minimal ingredients and refined technique.

ingredients.title: Ingredients (per omelet)
items: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter (plus extra for the pan)
Fresh herbs (chives, parsley, tarragon) for garnish

instruction.title: 1. Beat the eggs gently
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl. Add a pinch of salt (and white pepper if using).
Beat lightly with a fork or whisk—just enough to combine yolks and whites evenly. Avoid over-beating; you want some air but not a frothy foam.

instruction.title: 2. Prepare the pan
steps: Use a small, nonstick, or well-seasoned 8-inch sauté pan.
Heat over medium-low heat. Add 1 tablespoon butter and let it melt slowly. The butter should foam gently but not brown.

instruction.title: 3. Cook slowly, stir gently
steps: Pour the eggs into the pan.
With a silicone spatula, stir continuously in small circles while shaking the pan gently, keeping the eggs moving.
The goal is to create tiny curds that are very soft and creamy.

instruction.title: 4. Shape the omelet
steps: When eggs are mostly set but still slightly runny on top (the residual heat will finish cooking), stop stirring.
Tilt the pan to let the eggs gather into a smooth oval shape.
Fold one side over the other with the spatula or gently roll the omelet onto a plate seam-side down.

instruction.title: 5. Finishing touch
steps: Add a small pat of butter on top if desired for shine.
Serve immediately—French omelets are best warm and just off the stove.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately—French omelets are best warm and just off the stove.

chefTips: Low and slow is key: cooking over high heat will toughen the eggs.
Use unsalted butter for a clean, creamy flavor.
Avoid browning: a French omelet should be pale yellow and smooth.
No fillings are needed for pure silkiness, but delicate options like fine herbs, soft cheese, or smoked salmon can be added sparingly.
Serve on a pre-warmed plate for that 5-star presentation.
